title: Does the faulty traffic light pass the test?
instruction: You are testing the traffic light from the table with a bug in its last row. Which tests pass, and which reveal the bug?

items.text: A press on red starts the countdown
items.why: The first row of the table is correct.

items.text: After the countdown the light turns green
After a while green starts flashing
After flashing the light turns red
items.why: The table sends the light back to green. Here is the bug.

items.text: A press on green changes nothing
items.why: Even the row “nothing happens” has to be in the table, and it is.

items.text: After one press, it is red again within two minutes
items.why: The light never gets back to red.

debrief: Only a test that goes through the last transition reveals the bug. That is why tests cover every row of the table, not just the beginning.
